description:
Intent i009 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=rtnl-doit-attr-gaps) complete with 2 high-confidence findings. Both are rtnetlink RTM_SETLINK bridge-mode attribute gaps matching the seed mechanism (optional netlink attribute fetched, then dereferenced without a covering NULL check):

1. drivers/net/ethernet/intel/i40e/i40e_main.c:12774-12776 — i40e_ndo_bridge_setlink() fetches br_spec = nlmsg_find_attr(nlh, sizeof(struct ifinfomsg), IFLA_AF_SPEC) and passes it directly to nla_for_each_nested(attr, br_spec, rem) with NO 'if (!br_spec)' guard. nla_for_each_nested expands to nla_for_each_attr(pos, nla_data(nla), nla_len(nla), rem) (include/net/netlink.h:1931-1932), so a NULL br_spec is dereferenced.

2. drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_main.c:6651-6653 — ice_bridge_setlink() has the identical missing guard: nlmsg_find_attr result passed straight into nla_for_each_nested.

Evidence chain: untrusted source = userspace RTM_SETLINK (PF_BRIDGE) message; IFLA_AF_SPEC is optional in ifla_policy (net/core/rtnetlink.c:1869, NLA_NESTED, not required) so nlmsg_find_attr returns NULL when it is omitted; the dispatcher rtnl_bridge_setlink (net/core/rtnetlink.c:4886-4921) guards its own br_spec but forwards the raw nlh to dev->netdev_ops->ndo_bridge_setlink on the BRIDGE_FLAGS_SELF path (line 4920), reaching the unguarded driver handlers; consequence = NULL-pointer dereference oops (local DoS) when an attacker includes IFLA_BRIDGE_FLAGS=BRIDGE_FLAGS_SELF but omits IFLA_AF_SPEC.

Counterevidence: of the six nlmsg_find_attr(IFLA_AF_SPEC) consumers in the snapshot, only i40e and ice lack the 'if (!br_spec) return -EINVAL;' guard — bnxt.c:12461, be_main.c:4982, ixgbe_main.c:9898, mlx5 en_main.c:4536 all guard it, as do rtnl_bridge_setlink/dellink themselves, making the two reported sites the outliers.

Other classified candidates (10 total, 8 safe / 1 unresolved): rtnl_bridge_setlink and rtnl_bridge_dellink (guarded), bnxt/be2net/ixgbe/mlx5 bridge_setlink (guarded), br_setlink in br_netlink.c (jointly guarded), neigh_delete NDA_DST (guarded), qeth_l2_bridge_setlink (has_protinfo gate); unresolved: the ~60 per-kind rtnl_link_ops newlink/changelink tb[] handlers were only pattern-surveyed, not individually read — noted as a limitation along with non-re-verification of the netlink permission path and hardware-state prerequisites (i40e PF VSI / ice device) for the two findings. Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i009.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"], execution_status=complete.
